option.description: Advanced override. When non-empty, this ECharts option replaces the generated chart and the domain props are ignored.

value.description: The value shown. Bind it to a tag. Anything that is not a number draws an empty dial with a dash.

max.description: End of the scale. If it is not greater than min, the scale is 0 to 100.

variant.description: The look of the dial. progress: a thick rounded arc filled up to the value, with the scale around it. stages: a wide band coloured by the stages, with a needle. grade: a thin band coloured by the stages with their names written along it, and a pointer. minimal: an arc and the value only, for small tiles.

stages.description: Value bands as objects { upTo, color, name }. A value belongs to the first stage, in ascending order of upTo, whose upTo is greater than it; a stage without upTo takes everything above. The stages colour the band of the stages and grade variants, and the arc and value of the other two by the stage the value is in. The name is written along the band of the grade variant and shown in the tooltip. Empty for no stages.

color.description: Colour of the arc, the pointer and the value when there are no stages, or none takes the value.

target.description: A marker across the scale at this value, e.g. a setpoint or a limit. Null for none.

showScale.description: Draw the ticks and numbers of the scale. The minimal variant has none; the grade variant has ticks only.

showValue.description: Write the value in the dial.

splitNumber.description: Number of labelled divisions of the scale. 0 chooses one that gives round steps.

startAngle.description: Angle in degrees where the scale starts: 90 is the top, 180 the left, 0 the right. The scale runs clockwise. Null centres the opening of the dial at the bottom.

sweep.description: Angle in degrees the scale covers (30-360). Null is 180 for the grade variant and 270 for the others.

theme.description: Name of a registered ECharts theme. Built-in themes: IgnitionIndustrialDark, IgnitionIndustrialLight. Leave empty for the ECharts default theme.

renderer.description: Rendering engine: canvas (better perf) or svg (better quality/export).

autoResize.description: Automatically resize chart when container dimensions change.

resizeDebounceMs.description: Debounce interval in milliseconds for resize events.

notMerge.description: If true, setOption will not merge with previous option but replace entirely.

lazyUpdate.description: If true, chart update is deferred for better performance during rapid changes.

showLoading.description: Show the built-in ECharts loading animation.

loadingOptions.description: Options for the loading animation (text, color, etc.).

sanitizeTooltip.description: Sanitises HTML in tooltip formatters and blocks non-http(s) links.

ariaLabel.description: Accessible label announced by screen readers.

maps.description: Map definitions for map and geo series, keyed by map name. Each value is a GeoJSON FeatureCollection, or an object with an `svg` string. Set series.map (or geo.map) to the key.
